column1: table s34: trends in worry about crime, year ending december 1992 to year ending march 2016 csew1
Source: Crime Survey for England and Wales, Office for National Statistics
1. See Section 6.2 of the User Guide for more information on the definitions of the worry about crime indicators.
2. Questions on worry about crime were only asked of one-quarter of the CSEW sample from year ending March 2009.

3. Unweighted bases refer to high levels of worry about burglary. Bases for violent crime will be similar but for car crime will be slightly lower as this is based only on those residing in households owning, or with regular use of, a vehicle.
